title: OfflinePassIssuanceRequest
description: HTTP request body sent by the mobile app to the server's pass issuance endpoint (POST /api/v1/offline/passes) per spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3. Carries the device key the server binds into the pass, and on the first request for a key the platform's attestation of it. The server's response is defined by offline-pass-issuance-response.schema.json.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device requesting the pass. Copied into the pass's deviceId.

devicePublicKey.description: The P-256 public key of the device key, compressed SEC1, Base64: a key pair the app generated in the phone's hardware-backed keystore with a non-exportable private key (spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3.2). Copied into the pass's devicePublicKey.

deviceKeyAttestation.description: The platform's attestation that the device key is hardware-backed (spec/profiles/offline/app-contract.md 3.6): Android Key Attestation or Apple App Attest. The server issues no pass for a device key whose attestation it has not verified; the app sends it with its first pass request for a key.

certificateChain.description: The device key's attestation certificate chain from the Android Keystore, leaf first, each certificate DER and Base64. The leaf's public key is devicePublicKey, and its key description carries the challenge.

keyId.description: The App Attest key identifier, Base64: the SHA-256 of the key's public key, X9.62 uncompressed.

attestationObject.description: The App Attest attestation object, CBOR, Base64. Its credential certificate's public key is devicePublicKey, and its nonce covers the SHA-256 of the challenge.

challenge.description: The challenge of the server's attestation-challenge response (offline-attestation-challenge-response.schema.json) this attestation carries.
